answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 154 Country: QA Title: I am married to a Shaafi and i am Hanafi. According to Hanafi madhab calamari is not permissible. Question: According to Hambali and Shaafi madhab anything from the sea is halaal. I am married to a Shaafi and i am Hanafi. According to Hanafi madhab calamari is not permissible. Why is it halaal for my wife to serve this on our supper table and i am not allowed to eat it. Please advise. Answer ID: 154 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 136=135/L) Yes, it is correct that according to Ahnaf in sea animals only fish is allowed to eat and the rest are prohibited: اما الذی یعیش في البحر فجمیع ما في البحر من الحیوان محرم الاکل الا السمک خاصة فانہ یحل اکلہ الا ما طفا منہ (بدائع الصنائع، 5/35 ، کتاب الذبائح والصیود) Therefore, if calamari is not a fish then it will not be permissible to consume it. (for details, please see: والصیود بدائع الصنائع، اول کتاب الذبائح ( Every one of you (wife and husband) has to follow his imam; there is no need to look for daleel: علی ان الواجب العمل بقول المجتھد و ان لم یظھر دلیلہ (شامی، 41/396 ) So, you have to follow your imam and your wife has to follow her imam. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
